name: dreamship-mcp
description: Dreamship (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, create_order, get_order. Every tool

platform_mcp_dreamship_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DREAMSHIP_API_KEY
platform_mcp_dreamship_api_key.description: Dreamship API key from Settings (https://dreamship.com/app/settings), sent as `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`.

platform_mcp_dreamship_test_order.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DREAMSHIP_TEST_ORDER
platform_mcp_dreamship_test_order.description: Set to true to send `test_order: true` on create_order (test orders are not billed or fulfilled); left out of the body when unset, so orders are real.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Dreamship has no account endpoint; the probe lists the connected shops ({paging{count, next, previous}, data[{id, key, name, channel, shop_url, status}]}). Rate limit 60 calls/minute.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /items/ lists Dreamship's blank catalogue items ({paging{count, next, previous}, data[{id, name, description, colors, sizes, options, print_areas, ship_zones, starting_basic_cost, release_status}]}); `query` and `category` are not accepted here (items of one category come from GET /categories/{id}/items/, not mapped). Costs are decimal strings (starting_basic_cost), so `price` is left empty.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /items/{id}/: the item with item_variants[{id, name, color, size, cost, basic_cost, availability}], print_areas[{key, w, h, dpi}] and ship_zones[{countries, ship_zone_methods[{method, cost, delivery_days_min, delivery_days_max}]}] in `raw`. Order line_items use item_variant ids and print_area keys from here.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: POST /orders/ places a real, billed order unless the test_order setting is true. `shipping_address` is Dreamship's address {first_name, last_name, street1, street2, city, state, zip, country (ISO-2), phone, force_verified_delivery}; `items` are line_items [{item_variant | product_variant, quantity, print_areas[{key, url}]}]; `shipping_option` is shipping_method (economy, express, ground, two_day, ...). Costs are decimal strings (total_cost).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /orders/{id}/: {id, status (draft, submitted, accepted, rejected, partially_fulfilled, fulfilled, cancelled), payment_status, total_cost (decimal string), created_at, line_items, fulfillments[{trackings[{carrier, status, tracking_number, tracking_url}]}]}; `tracking_number` is the first fulfillment's first tracking.
